⚡ Kaise Use Karein — Step by Step
1 Photo Yes/No chunein — Personal tab ke sabse upar batayein ki biodata mein photo chahiye ya nahi
2 Form bharo — Upar diye form mein apni saari details carefully bharo (Personal, Family, Education, Expectations)
3 Template chuno — Right side mein apni pasand ka template image pe click karo. Full preview dekhne ke liye image pe tap karo
4 "Generate" button dabao — Aapka prompt automatically copy ho jayega aur ChatGPT new tab mein khul jayega
5 ChatGPT mein paste karo — ChatGPT ke chat box mein Ctrl+V (ya mobile pe long press → paste) karke Enter dabao. Agar photo wala option chuna hai, to apni photo bhi yahin attach kar sakte hain
6 Biodata ready! 🎉 ChatGPT aapki saari details ke saath selected template mein professional biodata bana dega — neeche "Smart Csc Tools" watermark ke saath
💡 Tip: Apna khud ka pasandida design use karna hai? "✨ Custom / Blank Template" select karein aur ChatGPT mein apni design ki image bhi attach kar dein — wahi look mil jayega!

❓ Aksar Puche Jane Wale Sawaal (FAQ)

Kya yeh tool bilkul free hai?

Haan, smartcsctools.org ka AI Biodata Maker 100% free hai. Koi registration ya payment nahi chahiye.

Biodata kaisa generate hoga?

Form fill karne ke baad ChatGPT automatically ek professional, print-ready A4 biodata image banata hai aapki details ke saath.

Kya mujhe ChatGPT account chahiye?

Haan, ChatGPT.com par ek free account banana hoga. Generate button click karte hi ChatGPT khul jayega aur aap prompt paste kar sakte hain.

Kaunse templates available hain?

4 professional templates hain: Orange Decorative, Dark Purple Royal, Maroon Traditional, aur White Elegant — sabhi Hindu marriage ke liye perfect.

Kya main apni photo add kar sakta/sakti hun?

Haan, ChatGPT mein prompt paste karne ke baad aap apni photo bhi upload kar sakte hain. AI photo ke saath complete biodata banata hai.

Biodata print ho sakta hai?

Haan, ChatGPT dwara banaya gaya biodata A4 size mein hota hai jise aap directly print ya PDF mein save kar sakte hain.
